criteria.describe: Every number, name, PR, epic and quote matches the data. A PR's epic is its epicPath; no path means no epic.
Every merged PR has a card; every direct commit is a card's ref or in some card's with.
Sections group changes by meaning and come in the order a teammate would care about them.
Headlines and plain text make sense to someone who doesn't read the code; paths, flags and test names are in tech.
Short sentences, no hype or filler, right types and parts, house style for links and code.
